Sweet Treat: Eggless Banoffee Pie
By: ravikumar
Published: Thursday, October 5, 2017 - 2:08am

Ingredients




1 can condensed Milk
125 gms butter, unsalted
50 gms icing Sugar
200 gms flour
4-5 bananas, sliced
1 bowl chocolate shavings
1 bowl whipped cream

Preparation

1 1. Heat water in a pan and keep the can of condensed milk in it for 3 hours. 2 2. In a separate bowl, add butter, icing sugar & flour, combine it and knead it into a dough. 3 3. Wrap the dough using a plastic wrap and chill it for about 30 mins. 4 4. Once that is done, grease a tart ring with butter and keep. 5 5. Remove the dough from the wrap and roll it flat. 6 6. Place the flattened dough in the tart ring using a rolling pin. In the tart ring, push the tart so that it takes the shape of the ring. 7 7. Using a knife remove the excess dough and with a fork make holes in the dough. 8 8. Next, chill it for 20 mins in a freezer and blind-bake it for 180 deg C for 25 mins. 9 9. Once everything is ready, add the condensed milk into the tart and spread it evenly. 10 10. Then add the bananas & whipped cream and spread it. 11 11. Lastly top it with some chocolate shavings and serve!

About

The Eggless banoffee pie here is the best recipe in the world it’s time to make this authentic Delicious Eggless banoffee pie Recipe at home and served with love. The Eggless banoffee pie is nice in taste and the aroma is wow.
